On a multi-org host a per-org unit that binds a port takes it from its registry entry (S3b 5/n); until then it is NOT written there, with its reason. One org: nothing here is read, every unit is what it was. A stem units() writes that is absent here fails the oracle (tests/test_org_home_units_scope.py).
